{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

print(f"Total duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check how many times each patient_id appears
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Identify patients with multiple entries
multi_entry_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple entries: {len(multi_entry_patients)}")
print(f"Distribution of entries per patient: {dict(multi_entry_patients)}")"}
